overview: By the time the pane was grey the sheet had come down to the woes, and the nurse was at the door. Eighty lines. Your own candle was at the socket. No lark had sung. The noise outside was rooks. You did not copy the sheet fair, and you did not tie it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Finished the stretch at the nurse's door and did not make a fair copy.

assets.name: Verona
assets.disposition: Wrote eighty lines, down to the nurse at the door

important_dates.meaning: The woes, and the nurse at the door

summary: Wrote eighty lines, down to the nurse at the door
